strings.zh: 桔梗市周围有很多的飞行系精灵,{NEWLINE}可是相应的虫系和草系就非常少了。{CLEAR}我一直很喜欢的口袋妖怪椰蛋树,{CLEAR}在这一带是完全不可能遇到的。{CLEAR}如果你有椰蛋树的话,{CLEAR}可以跟我的盔甲鸟交换吗？
strings.en: There are lots of Flying{NEWLINE}types around Violet City, but hardly{CLEAR}any Bug or Grass types. I’ve always{CLEAR}loved Exeggutor, and you just can’t{CLEAR}find one anywhere around here.{SCROLL}If you have an Exeggutor, would{NEWLINE}you trade it for my Skarmory?

strings.zh: 我的黑暗鸦的特性是恶作剧之心,{NEWLINE}是可以抢先使出{CLEAR}变化技能的超棒特性哦。
strings.en: My Murkrow’s Ability is Prankster.{NEWLINE}It lets it use status moves{CLEAR}first. It’s an awesome Ability!

strings.zh: 黑暗鸦『Muuu——ro！
strings.en: Murkrow: Muuu-ro!

strings.zh: 不愿意吗？{NEWLINE}果然草系精灵非常受欢迎啊。
strings.en: You don’t want to? I guess{NEWLINE}Grass types really are popular.

strings.zh: 咱们交换要讲诚信,{NEWLINE}我要的是椰蛋树,{CLEAR}你不要拿别的精灵来糊弄我。
strings.en: A trade has to be honest. I want{NEWLINE}an Exeggutor, so don’t try to{CLEAR}palm some other Pokémon off on me.

strings.zh: 终于得到我梦寐以求的椰蛋树了,{NEWLINE}真的非常感谢你。
strings.en: At last, I’ve got the Exeggutor I’ve{NEWLINE}always dreamed of! Thank you so much.

strings.zh: 你应该拥有很多徽章吧？{NEWLINE}以你现在的实力,{CLEAR}任何交换来的精灵{CLEAR}都会对你绝对服从的。
strings.en: You must have plenty of Badges, right?{NEWLINE}As strong as you are, any Pokémon you{CLEAR}trade for will obey you completely.

strings.zh: 一个金灿灿的奖杯。
strings.en: A shiny golden trophy.

strings.zh: 我当年参加铁人三项比赛,{NEWLINE}获得了地区冠军。{CLEAR}家里的奖杯就是那时候赢得的。{CLEAR}它对我来说是非常重要的宝物。
strings.en: Back in the day, I entered a triathlon{NEWLINE}and became the regional champion.{CLEAR}That’s when I won the trophy at{CLEAR}home. It’s a real treasure to me.
strings.notes: zh 铁人三项 (triathlon) here, 马拉松健将 (marathon runner) in 0550 #54; both kept.

strings.zh: 我很擅长跑步,{NEWLINE}所以也特别喜欢跑得快的精灵。{CLEAR}在众多擅长奔跑的精灵中,{CLEAR}就属烈焰马最绚丽华美了。{CLEAR}如果你有烈焰马的话,{CLEAR}能拿来给我看看吗？
strings.en: I’m great at running, so I especially{NEWLINE}love fast Pokémon. Of all the Pokémon{CLEAR}that are great runners, Rapidash{CLEAR}is the most dazzling. If you have a{CLEAR}Rapidash, could you show it to me?

strings.zh: 你也没有烈焰马啊……
strings.en: You don’t have a Rapidash either...

strings.zh: 这不是烈焰马啊。
strings.en: That’s not a Rapidash.

strings.zh: 哇！这真的是烈焰马。{NEWLINE}这矫健的身形、昂扬的体态,{CLEAR}像极了一位蓄势待发的运动员！{CLEAR}真是太美丽了。{SCROLL}非常感谢你让我看到了珍贵的烈焰马,{NEWLINE}作为回报这个送给你了。
strings.en: Wow! It really is a Rapidash! That{NEWLINE}strong, graceful build, that proud{CLEAR}stance... Just like an athlete about to{CLEAR}spring into action! It’s so beautiful.{SCROLL}Thank you so much for showing{NEWLINE}me such a precious Rapidash.{CLEAR}Please take this in return.

strings.zh: 不……！我的奖杯！{NEWLINE}那是我最重要的奖杯啊！{CLEAR}拜托你一定要帮我找回来啊,求你了！
strings.en: No...! My trophy! That trophy{NEWLINE}means more to me than anything!{CLEAR}Please, you’ve got to get it{CLEAR}back for me! I’m begging you!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『阿速馆主,{NEWLINE}案件调查有进展了吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Falkner, any{NEWLINE}progress on the case?

strings.zh: 阿速『根据失主的目击信息,{NEWLINE}偷走奖杯的人穿着黑色衣服,{CLEAR}胸前有一个红色的R字标记,{CLEAR}应该是火箭队没错了。
strings.en: Falkner: According to the owner, the{NEWLINE}thief wore black clothes with a red R{CLEAR}on the chest. It must be Team Rocket.

strings.zh: 那是对我很重要的冠军奖杯,{NEWLINE}拜托一定要帮我找回来啊。
strings.en: That championship trophy{NEWLINE}means so much to me. Please,{CLEAR}you’ve got to get it back.

strings.zh: 阿速『你放心,我绝对不会让火箭队{NEWLINE}在桔梗市为所欲为。
strings.en: Falkner: Don’t worry. I will{NEWLINE}never let Team Rocket do as{CLEAR}they please in Violet City.

strings.zh: 阿速馆主！
strings.en: Falkner, sir!

strings.zh: 阿速『不好！
strings.en: Falkner: This is bad!

strings.zh: 阿速『{VAR:0103:0}先生,{NEWLINE}桔梗道馆好像出事了,{CLEAR}我得赶紧回去确认一下{CLEAR}绿色宝珠的安全。
strings.en: Falkner: Mr. {VAR:0103:0}, something{NEWLINE}seems to have happened at the{CLEAR}Violet Gym. I must hurry back and{CLEAR}make sure the Jade Orb is safe.
strings.notes: Gender pair #20 (先生) / #21 (小姐): Mr./Miss as in 0490 #10.

strings.zh: 阿速『{VAR:0103:0}小姐,{NEWLINE}桔梗道馆好像出事了,{CLEAR}我得赶紧回去确认一下{CLEAR}绿色宝珠的安全。
strings.en: Falkner: Miss {VAR:0103:0}, something{NEWLINE}seems to have happened at the{CLEAR}Violet Gym. I must hurry back and{CLEAR}make sure the Jade Orb is safe.

strings.zh: 刚刚前任馆主绿稚先生{NEWLINE}去了桔梗道馆,{CLEAR}不顾我们阻止上了二层,{CLEAR}然后从对战台后面的墙体里{CLEAR}敲出来一个方形盒子带走了。{CLEAR}您要不要回去看一下？
strings.en: The former Leader, Mr. Verdell,{NEWLINE}just went to the Violet Gym. He{CLEAR}ignored us when we tried to stop him{CLEAR}and went up to the second floor.{SCROLL}Then he broke a square box out of the{NEWLINE}wall behind the battlefield and took it{CLEAR}away. Will you go back and take a look?

strings.zh: 阿速『怎么急成这个样子,{NEWLINE}有话慢慢说。
strings.en: Falkner: Why the panic? Calm{NEWLINE}down and tell me slowly.
